title: Los Angeles County Extreme Heat Press Conference 3/16/26
description:
To access language translations for this meeting, visit: https://attend.wordly.ai/join/ZSJR-1247

Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors Chair and First District Supervisor Hilda L. Solis will host a press conference today at 12:30 p.m. to share updates on the approaching heat wave and the steps Los Angeles County is taking to support residents during the anticipated high temperatures.

An Extreme Heat Warning is expected to take effect Tuesday, March 17, at 10 a.m. and remain in place through Friday, March 20, at 8 p.m. County officials will provide information on available cooling centers, public health guidance and countywide response efforts.
